While Wynants et al. reviewed multivariable models with any type of clinical input data, the present review focuses specifically on machine learning-based diagnostic and prognostic models using medical imaging.

In this systematic review, we consider all published papers and preprints, for the period from 1 January 2020 to 3 October 2020, which describe new machine learning models for the diagnosis or prognosis of COVID-19 from CXR or CT images.
